Admin bulk-import endpoint. Accepts up to 25 issue payloads in a single
request and processes each independently — translation failures,
upload-attach errors, and per-row DB errors are captured per-item and
reported in the response, rather than aborting the whole batch.

  English title), the same way single-create does.

a `summary` of how many succeeded vs. failed.

get.summary: Get the full admin analytics report (admin only)
get.description:
Returns a single aggregated report covering all admin-panel domains:
overview KPIs, users, issues, events, engagement (votes), feedback,
participation applications, uploads, and geographic distribution.

## Date range
Optional `fromDate` / `toDate` filter the "period" counts and the time
series; lifetime counts always reflect the active filters but ignore
the date range. When both dates are provided the previous equal-length
period is auto-computed and used to produce `overview.deltaPercent`.

## Bucketing
Time series are auto-bucketed:
- `<= 31 days` → daily
- `<= 180 days` → weekly
- otherwise (or no range) → monthly

Pass `bucket` to override the auto-pick.

## Section selection
Pass `sections` as a CSV (e.g. `sections=overview,issues,events`) to
compute only the listed sections — useful for narrow dashboards or
reducing query load. Omit to return everything.

## Advanced filtering
Each filter narrows the section it belongs to. The overview totals
and period counts also respect every active filter, so the response
stays internally consistent.

Filter groups:
- **Geographic** (issues, events, geographic): `municipality`, `ward`
- **Users**: `userRole`, `userVerified`, `userIsOAuth`
- **Issues**: `issueStatus`, `issueCategory`
- **Events**: `eventStatus`, `eventRiskLevel`, `eventLeaderVotingStatus`
- **Engagement (issue votes)**: `voterRole` (+ issue filters propagate)
- **Feedback**: `feedbackType`, `feedbackStatus`
- **Applications**: `applicationRole`, `applicationStatus`
- **Uploads**: `uploadFileType`, `uploadIsConfirmed`, `uploadLinkedTo`

Top-N lists (top voted issues, top leaders, top contributors,
upcoming events) are sized by `topN` (default 10, max 50).

## Example queries
- Last 30 days, daily buckets:
  `?fromDate=2026-04-27T00:00:00Z&toDate=2026-05-27T00:00:00Z`
- OPEN roadside issues in Pokhara only:
  `?issueStatus=OPEN&issueCategory=ROADSIDE&municipality=Pokhara%20Metropolitan%20City`
- Just the events + uploads sections:
  `?sections=events,uploads`
- Completed events with risk URGENT, weekly buckets:
  `?eventStatus=COMPLETED&eventRiskLevel=URGENT&bucket=week`
- Confirmed image uploads orphaned from entities:
  `?uploadFileType=IMAGE&uploadIsConfirmed=true&uploadLinkedTo=orphan`

get.summary: Get the public community-impact report (any signed-in user)
get.description:
A curated, community-facing subset of the admin report. Designed for
general users — it surfaces transparency-style stats (community size,
issues raised, events run, votes cast, geographic distribution) while
omitting anything internal:

Excluded sections / fields (vs. admin report):
- `feedback`, `applications`, `uploads` sections
- Per-user `email` in `topContributors`
- `byRole` user breakdown, `oauth` / `native` counts
- `overview.previousPeriod` and `overview.deltaPercent`

## Sections (CSV via `sections`)
- `overview` — community totals + period counts (users/issues/events/votes)
- `community` — community size, verified %, new-joins time series, top
  contributors (by issues reported, votes cast, events led)
- `issues` — totals, by status/category/municipality, top voted,
  time series
- `events` — totals, by status/risk, upcoming, attendance, top leaders,
  time series
- `engagement` — issue votes + leader votes (totals + series)
- `geographic` — issues/events distribution by municipality + ward

Date range, bucket selection, and `topN` behave identically to the
admin report. See `/api/v1/reports` for details.

Filters supported:
- `municipality`, `ward`
- `issueStatus`, `issueCategory`
- `eventStatus`, `eventRiskLevel`, `eventLeaderVotingStatus`
- `voterRole`

post.summary: Request a presigned URL for an unauthenticated upload (images and PDFs only)
post.description:
Public endpoint used by forms that accept attachments from non-logged-in
users (e.g. the participation/contributor application form). Only
`image/*` and `application/pdf` mime types are accepted. The resulting
upload is created with `userId = null` and stored privately.

mimeType.description: Must be an image/* mime type or application/pdf.

201.description: Presigned URL issued. Use it to PUT the file to R2, then call the public confirm endpoint.

post.summary: Confirm an unauthenticated upload
post.description:
Counterpart to `/uploads/public/presign`. Only confirms uploads that
were created via the public presign endpoint (i.e. have no owner).

403.description: Upload belongs to a user and cannot be confirmed via the public endpoint

201.description: Presigned URL issued. Use it to PUT the file to R2, then call confirm.

post.summary: Create a user (admin only)
post.description:
Creates a user directly without sending an SMS OTP. The user is marked
verified immediately and can log in right away. Intended for admins
provisioning accounts (e.g. staff, seeded test users) where the phone
verification flow should be bypassed.

409.description: Email, phone, or username already in use

get.summary: List users (admin only)
get.description:
Paginated list of users. Soft-deleted users are excluded. Supports
filtering by role / verification status and a case-insensitive search
across email, name, username, and phone.

get.summary: Get a user by id (admin only)

delete.description:
Tombstones the user record: sets `deletedAt`, redacts PII (email,
phone, username, name, avatar, bio, city, preferences) and revokes
all active refresh-token sessions. Foreign keys on issues, votes,
and events the member produced are preserved.

Idempotent: deleting an already-tombstoned user returns the existing
record without error.

An admin cannot soft-delete themselves or another admin.

403.description: Cannot delete self or another admin.

patch.description:
Promote/demote between USER, MODERATOR, and ADMIN. An admin cannot
change their own role.

post.summary: Set a member's medical-credential verification status (admin only)
post.description:
Toggles `medicalCredentialVerified`. Verification is required before
the member can hold the `MEDIC` participation role on any event.

patch.summary: Set a member's leader eligibility (admin only)
patch.description: Moves the member between leader-eligibility states.

get.summary: Get a user's public profile (no auth required)
get.description:
Curated, public-facing view. Includes the member's contribution stats:
issuesReported, votesCast, eventsLed, eventsJoined. Excludes PII like
email, phone, role, and admin-managed flags.
